services.name: Why Pilates
services.desc: Exercise won’t work if you don’t do it. That sounds really obvious, but most fitness routines are time-consuming, boring and really hard to stick with. Pilates is different. It is a form of exercise, but it is so much more. No matter how many skills you master, there are more to learn. Pilates is more like a sport than a workout because you are constantly challenged. It’s not about zoning out on a machine or doing countless repetitions. Doing Pilates requires you to continually think about how you are moving your body.
